description: A LINEAGE PASS establishes lineage for a question. It senses BOTH sides in one parallel phase — the external body of prior work (papers, precedent, canonical texts) and our own internal representations (repo, genome, wiki) — under least authority: the external sense holds only web tools, the internal sense holds only the wiki-read and working-tree tools, and neither can reach the other's substrate. Its core act is the second phase: drawing the connection between the two senses into a lineage-map of grounded edges, each saying our X descends-from / aligns-with / diverges-from / supersedes / informed-by their Y, grounded on both sides. It then judges the gap and plans the alignment, composes a formal lineage-record, and parks at a human approve chair whose sealed verdict is what promotes the record to first-class institutional lineage. The two senses are held by different seats, so no seat draws a connection to work it did not itself go and read.

phases.name: identify
phases.intent: Sense both sides in parallel, each seat under least authority. identify-external sweeps the external body of prior work with web tools and seals grounded lineage-hits; identify-internal sweeps our own repo, genome, and wiki with the wiki-read and working-tree tools and seals an internal-inventory. Neither seat holds the other's grant, and neither draws a connection — each produces a reading the next phase can be held to.

phases.name: associate
phases.intent: The core act. Reason over the two senses and DRAW THE CONNECTION: for each defensible pairing of an internal representation and an external source, a connection edge naming the relation (descends-from / aligns-with / diverges-from / supersedes / informed-by), grounded on BOTH sides. No external tools — this seat connects only what the senses retrieved, and drops any edge it cannot ground both ways. The lineage-map it seals IS the established lineage.

phases.name: assess
phases.intent: Judge the gap and plan the alignment off the drawn lineage. Where our internal state has no edge to a source the prior work establishes, or a source supersedes what we hold, name the gap plainly; then sequence the actions that would close it — cite, adopt, diverge deliberately, or supersede — sealed with the gap summary as an alignment-plan.

phases.name: compose
phases.intent: Compose the formal, publishable lineage-record: the identified external body, our internal inventory, the established connections, the gap, and the alignment recommendation — carrying each connection's both-side grounding through so the artifact is checkable citation by citation. Create only from upstream; introduce no new source.

phases.name: approve
phases.intent: A human approval office. The incumbent reviews the sealed lineage-record and either seals a passing lineage-verdict — which is what promotes the record to first-class lineage attached to an institution — or refuses it. A run that reaches this office unapproved PARKS awaiting the seal; nothing is adopted on an absent yes.
